format: NDCA professional and Pro/Am Student Competitor status (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A professional is anyone meeting listed conditions, such as being registered as a Professional with the NDCA or partnering a Pro/Am Student Competitor; a Pro/Am Student Competitor is a registered student of a registered professional and has further conditions.

requirement: DanceFlow's Professional and Student person types do NOT establish NDCA professional registration or Pro/Am Student status. A future NDCA profile must verify them from registration data.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile verification. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23 (II.A.1.a: 'Registered as a Professional with the NDCA'). Governing bodies do not define these terms as DanceFlow uses them; they do have their own professional, student and substitution classifications (NDCA II.A.1, II.A.4, XII.C.7), which are separate and not implemented.
